text_en: When Solomon had finished building the house of the Lord and the king’s house and all that Solomon desired to build,
text_cn: 撒罗满建造完了上主的殿、王宫和他所喜欢建造的一切建筑物以后，

text_en: the Lord appeared to Solomon a second time, as he had appeared to him at Gibeon.
text_cn: 上主第二次显现给撒罗满，像在基贝红显现给他一样。

text_en: The Lord said to him, “I have heard your prayer and your plea, which you made before me; I have consecrated this house that you have built, and put my name there forever; my eyes and my heart will be there for all time.
text_cn: 上主对他说：“我已应允了你在我面前所行的祈祷和哀求，我也祝圣了你所建筑的这殿，将我的名永远安放在那里，我的眼和我的心，也将时常留在那里。

text_en: As for you, if you will walk before me, as David your father walked, with integrity of heart and uprightness, doing according to all that I have commanded you, and keeping my statutes and my ordinances,
text_cn: 至于你，如果你在我面前行走，像你父亲达味那样行走，心地纯朴，公正无私，遵守我所吩咐你的一切，恪守我的法律和典章，

text_en: then I will establish your royal throne over Israel forever, as I promised your father David, saying, ‘There shall not fail you a successor on the throne of Israel. ’
text_cn: 我必永远巩固你在以色列中的王位，照我应许你父亲达味所说：你的子孙中，决不缺人坐上以色列的宝座。

text_en: “If you turn aside from following me, you or your children, and do not keep my commandments and my statutes that I have set before you, but go and serve other gods and worship them,
text_cn: 但是，如果你们或你们的子孙远离我，不遵守我给你们颁赐的诫命和律例，而去服侍敬拜别的神，

text_en: then I will cut Israel off from the land that I have given them; and the house that I have consecrated for my name I will cast out of my sight; and Israel will become a proverb and a taunt among all peoples.
text_cn: 我必要将以色列从我赐给他们的地面上除掉，而我为我的名所祝圣的这殿，我也必要弃之不顾，使以色列成为万民中的话柄和笑谈，

text_en: This house will become a heap of ruins; everyone passing by it will be astonished, and will hiss; and they will say, ‘Why has the Lord done such a thing to this land and to this house? ’
text_cn: 这殿要成为废墟，凡从这里经过的人，都要惊愕嗟叹说：上主为什么这样对待了这地和这殿？

text_en: Then they will say, ‘Because they have forsaken the Lord their God, who brought their ancestors out of the land of Egypt, and embraced other gods, worshiping them and serving them; therefore the Lord has brought this disaster upon them. ’”
text_cn: 人必回答说：是因为他们离弃了领他们的祖先出离埃及的上主，他们的天主，而归依、崇拜、服侍了别的神，为此，上主使这一切灾祸临到他们身上。”

text_en: At the end of twenty years, in which Solomon had built the two houses, the house of the Lord and the king’s house,
text_cn: 撒罗满费时二十年，才完成了那两大殿宇：即上主的殿宇和君王的宫殿。

text_en: King Hiram of Tyre having supplied Solomon with cedar and cypress timber and gold, as much as he desired, King Solomon gave to Hiram twenty cities in the land of Galilee.
text_cn: 其间提洛王希兰曾依照撒罗满的要求，供给了他香柏木、柏木和黄金。此时撒罗满王便将加里肋亚境内二十座城，送给了希兰。

text_en: But when Hiram came from Tyre to see the cities that Solomon had given him, they did not please him.
text_cn: 希兰从提洛前来，观看撒罗满送给他的城，一见就不满意，

text_en: Therefore he said, “What kind of cities are these that you have given me, my brother? ” So they are called the land of Cabul to this day.
text_cn: 说：“吾兄，你送给我的这些城，是些什么城？”因此直到今日，这些城仍称为加步耳地。

text_en: But Hiram had sent to the king one hundred twenty talents of gold.
text_cn: 希兰原送给了撒罗满王一百二十"塔冷通"黄金。

text_en: This is the account of the forced labor that King Solomon conscripted to build the house of the Lord and his own house, the Millo and the wall of Jerusalem, Hazor, Megiddo, Gezer
text_cn: 此段记载撒罗满征夫服役，建造上主的殿、王宫、米罗、耶路撒冷的城墙、哈祚尔、默基多、革则尔、

text_en: (Pharaoh king of Egypt had gone up and captured Gezer and burned it down, had killed the Canaanites who lived in the city, and had given it as dowry to his daughter, Solomon’s wife;
text_cn: 【以前，埃及王法郎曾上来，攻取了革则尔，放火烧城，屠杀了城里的客纳罕人，将这城赐给了自己的女儿，撒罗满的妻子，作为妆奁（lián）。

text_en: so Solomon rebuilt Gezer), Lower Beth-horon,
text_cn: 为此撒罗满重修了革则尔。】下贝特曷龙、

text_en: Baalath, Tamar in the wilderness, within the land,
text_cn: 巴拉特和境内靠近旷野的塔玛尔、

text_en: as well as all of Solomon’s storage cities, the cities for his chariots, the cities for his cavalry, and whatever Solomon desired to build, in Jerusalem, in Lebanon, and in all the land of his dominion.
text_cn: 撒罗满所有的贮货城、屯车城和养马城，以及撒罗满在耶路撒冷，在黎巴嫩，在他管辖的各地内，喜欢建造的一切建筑物。

text_en: All the people who were left of the Amorites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, who were not of the people of Israel—
text_cn: 至于不属于以色列子民的阿摩黎人、赫特人、培黎齐人、希威人和耶步斯人的遗族，

text_en: their descendants who were still left in the land, whom the Israelites were unable to destroy completely—these Solomon conscripted for slave labor, and so they are to this day.
text_cn: 就是以色列子民未能消灭而留在地方上的外族子孙，撒罗满都征来充作苦役，直到今天。

text_en: But of the Israelites Solomon made no slaves; they were the soldiers, they were his officials, his commanders, his captains, and the commanders of his chariotry and cavalry.
text_cn: 至于以色列子民，他不令他们作苦役，只叫他们服兵役，作朝臣、将帅、军官、战车长和骑兵长。

text_en: These were the chief officers who were over Solomon’s work: five hundred fifty, who had charge of the people who carried on the work.
text_cn: 管理撒罗满工程的主任官员，计有五百五十人，他们负责监督作工的人。

text_en: But Pharaoh’s daughter went up from the city of David to her own house that Solomon had built for her; then he built the Millo.
text_cn: 法郎的女儿从达味城，搬进撒罗满为她建造的宫室之后，撒罗满才开始建造米罗。

text_en: Three times a year Solomon used to offer up burnt offerings and sacrifices of well-being on the altar that he built for the Lord , offering incense before the Lord . So he completed the house.
text_cn: 撒罗满每年三次在他建的祭坛上，向上主奉献全燔祭与和平祭，在上主面前的香坛上焚香； 又常修理圣殿。

text_en: King Solomon built a fleet of ships at Ezion-geber, which is near Eloth on the shore of the Red Sea, in the land of Edom.
text_cn: 此后，撒罗满王又在厄东城，红海之滨，靠近厄拉特的厄兹雍革贝尔建造船只。

text_en: Hiram sent his servants with the fleet, sailors who were familiar with the sea, together with the servants of Solomon.
text_cn: 希兰派遣自己的臣仆，善于航海的船员，与撒罗满的仆人同船航行，

text_en: They went to Ophir, and imported from there four hundred twenty talents of gold, which they delivered to King Solomon.
text_cn: 去了敖非尔，从那里装载了四百二十"塔冷通"黄金，运到撒罗满王那里。
